sehemu: Part II: Consolidated Fund and Finances of the United Republic
maudhui: (1) The public debt shall be a charge upon the Consolidated Fund of the Government of the United Republic. (2) For purposes of this Article, the public debt includes the principal debt, interest payable on that debt, sinking fund payments for gradual repayment of the debt and all costs incidental to the management of that debt.
